audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gives Fiora level 1 and Jayce levels 3, 4-5 and first item — the reverse of what the whys say. whys[0] 'Jayce's acceleration-gate Shock Blast out-ranges your entire kit at level 1', whys[2] 'his hammer melee loses the trade', whys[3] 'flipping any peel attempt into your all-in', whys[5] 'still out-duels a one-item Jayce'. The 'early' text opens with 'Jayce owns level 1 outright'. Packet levelChart: Jayce / Skill / Fiora / Fiora / Fiora / Fiora / Jayce.
audit.why: Shock Blast is 16s at rank 1 with 600 range and gains range again through Acceleration Gate, against Fiora's 400-unit Lunge — she has no answer at level 1. From 3 she has Q plus E and he must swap to hammer to survive, which is the window the content already describes. Two items of poke reclaims it.
audit.corrected: Level 1 -> Jayce; Levels 3, 4-5 and First item -> Fiora; Level 2 stays Skill, Level 6 stays Fiora, 2+ items stays Jayce. Flipped as one atomic group in both layers.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why ends 'Jayce's ultimate changes the math too'. Jayce's R is a 6-second stance swap, not a power ultimate — nothing about level 6 changes for him.
audit.why: Kit text: R transforms hammer to cannon or back, on a 6s cooldown, with no rank-up power curve of the usual kind. Fiora's Grand Challenge, at 110s rank 1 with four Vital true-damage marks and a heal for her and nearby allies, is the only real level-6 event in this lane. The mirror audit made the matching correction from Jayce's side, rewriting his phases[4].why around the 110s figure.
audit.corrected: Rewrote phases[4].why around the 110s cooldown, the true damage and the team heal, and said plainly that his R is a stance swap.

audit.why: The decisive interaction is already right, is stated in four places, and matches the mirror exactly: Thundering Blow knocks back, so it is an immobilising effect, so Riposte blocking it upgrades Fiora's stab to a STUN — which turns his peel tool into her kill. The mirror flagged this as the most consequential finding in the matchup because it reverses the advice on Jayce's own page; both directions now say the same thing from opposite sides.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing states that swapping to Mercury Cannon resets his attack and that the first shot in that form shreds armour and magic resist.
audit.why: _missing/fiora.json flags autoreset-burst-tell for the stance swap, and the kit text adds the resistance shred: 'The first attack in this form reduces the target's Armor and Magic Resist.' That is the tell for his burst and the reason his follow-up hurts more than expected — neither appeared anywhere on the page.
audit.corrected: Put the reset and the shred into the poke-war don't.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet counted one sequencing cue in the whole matchup — every window was 'when Shock Blast is down' with no duration.
audit.why: Shock Blast is 16/14/12/10/8/6s and Thundering Blow 20/18/16/14/12/10s (six ranks each, since stance abilities level together). Those are long gaps at rank 1 and are the actual all-in windows.
audit.corrected: Attached the 16s Shock Blast figure to the close-the-gap do and the Acceleration Gate empowerment to the dodge do.

edits.before: Grand Challenge paints four vitals and the heal field wins any committed duel. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Jayce's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Grand Challenge is 110s and paints four Vitals in true damage, healing you and your allies — his R is only a 6s stance swap, so it changes nothing at 6.

edits.before: Q-lunge the exposed vital on Jayce, AA once, and E-slow out — repeat until his bar forces the all-in he loses.
edits.after: Fired through Acceleration Gate it gains speed, range and damage — sidestep early, not at the last moment.

edits.before: Jayce wastes Shock Blast — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Shock Blast is 16s at rank 1 — step in the moment it misses.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Thundering Blow knocks you back — parry it and the stun is his.

edits.before: Burning Riposte on poke — your W exists to delete his ONE key spell; waste it and the duel maths flips against you.
edits.after: Swapping to Mercury Cannon resets his attack and the first hit shreds your armour and MR — leave before it lands.

notes: Mirror reused: audits/top/jayce__fiora.json already established the Riposte-parries-Thundering-Blow-into-stun rule and rewrote his level-6 phase around Fiora's 110s Grand Challenge. This page already stated the parry rule correctly in four fields, so the two directions agree without any change on my side — I only added the matching 110s figure and killed the claim that 'Jayce's ultimate changes the math' at 6, since his R is a 6s stance swap. Chart flipped to the packet, which matched the whys exactly: the page said Fiora wins level 1 while its own early text opens 'Jayce owns level 1 outright'. New fact added from the kit: the stance swap into Mercury Cannon resets his attack AND the first shot in that form reduces armour and magic resist — that shred appeared nowhere on the page and explains why his follow-up burst lands harder than the poke suggests.
